thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — my flight is delayed, need to swap my Sat 00:00-08:00 oncall this weekend. Can anyone pick it up? I can take Mon 20:00-04:00 in exchange. Sorry for the short notice.

mina: I can take Sat overnight but would prefer someone to pair the first hour (00:00-01:00) — I'm not fully confident with the new KV-cache autoscaler yet.

ajd: tagging in case of workload patterns but I'm out this weekend.

alex: Thanks @mina. Two quick notes in the handoff: 1) run the prefix cache warmup before peak; 2) if p95 latency > 200ms, fail over to gpt-small-quant per runbook. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff

alex: Warmup script (run ~20m before slot):
```
./tools/cache_warmup.sh --model=gpt-small --prefix='prod:' --concurrency=4
# wait for 'warmup complete' in logs
```

oncall-bot: Handoff created for thread 2112223344 — calendar invite sent, Slack reminder at 23:30.

jordan: I can pair the first hour with @mina and shadow the rest. If anything strange, I'll take over. @tia FYI in case you want to be backup.

tia: I can cover Mon 20:00-04:00 instead of Alex. Confirmed. :thumbsup:

alex: Amazing, thank you all. Also keep an eye on the queue named 'prod-requests' — if pending > 500, set routing to the cheaper variant. Quick check: `curl -s "https://api.redwood.internal/queues/prod-requests" | jq '.pending'`

mina: Will run warmup at 23:40-23:50 and post status here. Any env flags I should set? batching advice?

jordan: For this weekend set: `BATCH_TARGET=16` and `KV_CACHE_TTL=1800`. Lower batch target causes higher throughput but watch latency.

alex: Added to the handoff notes. Logs to watch: serve/runtime/warmup, serve.latency.p95, and infra/kv-autoscaler. Escalation path is in the runbook.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Pager policy active — primary -> 15min -> oncall lead. See https://redwood.internal/policy/pager.

mina: Warmup started at 23:43, doing a quick smoke of prefix responses.

mina: Warmup done, green at 23:51. Logs show warmup complete and p95 steady at ~120ms. Handoff to @jordan for pairing now. Good luck :rocket:

jordan: Got it, pairing now. If anything pops, I'll escalate per runbook.
